title: Boatre Dame Fishing Charters

services.name: Evening - Cruise Charter
services.desc: Pricing - Hourly rate of $150 - Minimum trip time is 2 hours *Starting at $300 Experience the beauty of southern Lake Michigan on our 38 foot Trojan International boat. Ride the waves along the Dunes National Lakeshore with a sunset view of the Chicago Skyline. Boat will be operated by a US Coast Guard certified Captain, ensuring a safe and fun environment. Please BYOB, we will have bottled water available. *No fishing on this

services.name: Schedule a charter
services.desc: Pricing - $899 (1-6 guests) Afternoon charters typically leave the dock around 2pm central time. Captain will set start time if changes are necessary. Your fishing charter will include: - 6 hour (or fish limit) fishing trip on Lake Michigan - All fishing gear; rods, reels, lures provided - Safety Equipment (life-jackets, emergency radio, first aid) - Below deck storage for extra coolers, bags, clothing - All fish caught will be cleaned, filleted, and bagged to take home Max of 6 people. Captain Thomas will confirm all bookings after submitting a request, trip is not booked
